edit.anchor: on the quantity noun, not a separate `thing` argument.
edit.text: Neither the inner verb nor `have-quant-91` gets `:aspect` or a modal link, and `have-quant-91` gets no temporal link. A measure noun (circulation, sales, price) at another time or value is not coreferent; corefer only its owner.
Write an entity's full node (name, apposition) at its first occurrence in reading order; later mentions are re-entrancies.

edit.old: the original X is `:ARG1` and the result Y is `:ARG2`; never `:source`.
edit.new: the original X is `:ARG1` and the result Y is `:ARG2`; never `:source`. When X and Y are components (layout, edition, format) of the subject, the subject is `:part-of` on X, not its own argument and not an inverse `:part`.

edit.old: and the work is its `:part-of`; modifiers of the component (colour, style) stay on it.
edit.new: and the work is its `:part-of`; modifiers of the component (colour, style) stay on it. A trailing relative clause on such an object attaches to the component noun.

edit.old: Only verbs of publishing or reporting; the capacity or content of a publication (contains articles, has N pages) is not habitual (`process` or `state`).
edit.new: Only routine production practices (publishing, printing, issuing, reporting, broadcasting), also when the event is a noun used as an argument; what a publication contains or holds (articles, N pages) is not habitual but `process`.

edit.old: Copular and identity predicates get no temporal parent but do get a modal parent.
edit.new: Copular and identity predicates get no temporal parent but do get a modal parent. An `identity-91` reifying an apposition inside a noun phrase gets no `:aspect` and no links at all.

edit.new: explicitly continues from it (也/还 + 成/成为/变成, *also became*, *as a

edit.old: clearly a long span and the event a point inside it.
edit.new: explicitly a span (during, within, 期间); a year or decade takes `:overlap`.

edit.text: A connective opening a sentence (不过, 但是, 然而, 因此) that relates it to an earlier sentence gets no frame; annotate the clause alone.
